quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 354,343.63 ten-thousand, up 16.58% from RMB 303,956.79 ten-thousand; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB -861.15 ten-thousand (down 104.25%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -5,170.64 ten-thousand (down 130.08%). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 76,193.42 ten-thousand, Q2 RMB 96,183.81 ten-thousand, Q3 RMB 100,638.04 ten-thousand, Q4 RMB 81,328.36 ten-thousand (Q4 net profit RMB -4,609.56 ten-thousand). The company attributes the loss to forward investment in capacity, talent and R&D: as new Shenyang, Nantong and Beijing lines started and were transferred to fixed assets, fixed assets reached RMB 49.02 hundred million (+22%) and depreciation RMB 3.61 hundred million (+39%); labour cost RMB 8.71 hundred million (+20%); R&D expense RMB 2.73 hundred million (+24%). Product gross margin 22.23%; main-business gross margin 22.45%, down 3.47 percentage points, which it attributes to sharper competition in mature-node products, strategic investment and product mix. R&D investment RMB 27,349.93 ten-thousand (+23.53%), 7.72% of revenue. Operating cash flow RMB 38,679.01 ten-thousand on good customer collections.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 354,343.63 ten-thousand (+16.58%); net profit attributable RMB -861.15 ten-thousand (-104.25%); main-business gross margin 22.45%

Units: mechanical and electromechanical components produced 3,317,823 (+178.89%), sold 3,329,187 (+187.41%); gas delivery systems produced 346,046 (+65.96%), sold 338,516 (+63.71%). Gas delivery system orders rose more than 50% in 2025; the company calls the segment its second growth curve and says its domestic market share leads. Through a special-purpose vehicle with co-investors it is acquiring control of Zhejiang Puxin, which holds 96.56% of gas delivery system maker Compart; once completed, Fortune Precision will indirectly hold 21.58% of Compart, which it plans to use for technology and global supply-chain synergy.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced-process products (2025 annual report): it set up five product programmes - showerheads, special coatings, heaters, electrostatic chucks and valves - all aimed at advanced processes. Showerheads and special coatings completed key-customer validation and are in volume production; heaters and valves passed customer validation, and several valves won small-batch orders. Showerhead orders from some large customers rose 79% and 156% in 2025. Its O-series film passed a leading customer's certification and is in batch use; its ultra-high-density YO coating (porosity below 1%) is entering leading-customer validation; its high-reflectivity gold plating passed several leading domestic customers' certification with ten-million-RMB-level order delivery. The company says it can develop and mass-produce the high-precision, high-cleanliness metal parts needed for 7 nm and below and has delivered core precision metal parts in batches; several high-value products passed validation on domestic and overseas advanced logic and advanced memory lines.
quarterly_data.figure: showerhead orders from some large customers +79% and +156%

quarterly_data.quarter: Fortune Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company will focus in 2026 on the market launch and capacity release of heaters and valves, keep a 3-5 year development plan for electrostatic chucks (technology, customer validation, industrialisation), raise the market share of its volume-production showerheads and special coatings, and speed up construction and ramp of its production bases with dedicated capacity for the five programmes, aiming to raise the share of high-value products and move from parts supplier to components, system modules and one-stop solutions.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (2025 annual report): the Nantong IPO project (integrated-circuit equipment parts full-process intelligent manufacturing base) reached usable state in May 2024 and its capacity is being released; the Nantong subsidiary had 2025 revenue RMB 147,969.12 ten-thousand and net profit RMB 7,512.76 ten-thousand.
